title: Living Powers
description: This mods main focus is to provide a small list of powers that the player can obtain for a small edge during fights, or even just normal every day living. (submit an idea and you can have your power added to the mod)
body:
Welcome to the smallest superpower based mod you've come across! 

The purpose of this mod is not to add in some reconizable power or superhero. it simply aims at adding a small bonus section to your gameplay. 

non of the powers (other then god teir) out right break the game. because their not supposed to. 

if you would like this mod to receive more updates, downdload and follow me here, but also check out my youtube channel for commuinity posts and videos about the mods i make.

Living powers content: 
Squid like creatures that live in the water, when they die- they drop orbs. these orbs can be combined with objects to grant powers, or combined together to increase their own strength. which can then grant more powers. 

These powers include: 
Tier 1: Strength - provides strength 2.
Tier 1: Regeneration - provides regen 2.
Tier 1: speed - provides swiftness 2.
Tier 2: Teleport - Press "R" to teleport 14 blocks.
Tier 2: Extra hearts - Gain an extra row of hearts.
Tier 2: modification - provides water breathing, night vision, haste and fir resistance. 
Tier 3: Flight - allows the user to fly.
Tier GOD: Undead - forces a totem of undying into the offhand slot of the user- single time use power. 
Tier 3: Armor master - wearing differnt armors grants differnt power effects, such as strength or regen. 
Tier 3: Backup - Press "R" to summon an iron golem warror to fight for you!
